[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Saras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who infiltrated a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safeworld]] after being trained on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She found work on in the [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]]. After a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]], she was preparing to contact her handlers using a disguised [[Chandrilan worry doll]], but was summoned to the infirmary by [[Venner]] to scan an Imperial agent. When she arrived, the agent recognized her and she was taken into custody by the Rebels.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saras appears in the opening story for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''.<ref name="Strongholds" />
